insight: A little recent rain (3.9 mm) may be carrying some runoff to the shoreline — a modest upward pressure on bacteria. The model's main signals right now: high tide timing is raising risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach; high tide level is lowering risk — a high tide can mobilize bacteria held in wet sand and push the waterline toward outfalls; and higher waves is raising risk — bigger waves stir up the seabed and resuspend sediment-bound bacteria. The most recent sample, 7 days ago, was excellent at 20 MPN/100mL.
